findings.text: Early CPU memory setup entry that establishes a safe default translation environment and yields a system control value for the caller to enable address translation.

Guarantees sanitized privileged state on the setup path by invalidating local translation caches with an ordering barrier and disabling lower-privilege access to floating, debug, performance and activity controls before programming translation registers.

Translation and attribute controls start from architecture defaults for cacheability, shareability and address sizes, then adapt to probed capabilities such as extended address width, physical size, hardware access-flag support, permission indirection and extended control availability, retaining defaults when a feature is absent.

Protection decoding table where each element associates a mask and expected value with readable labels for match and mismatch, collectively covering validity, privilege, writability, two execute-permission states, shareability, access state, globality, contiguity, block form, guarded-page state and memory-type classes.

Array of five translation-stage descriptors sharing one decoding table and entry count, each accumulating a combined mask over its decoding entries during boot initialization for later protection extraction.

Output helpers emit formatted text only when a sequence destination is present, and protection rendering walks the decoding table selecting the matching label for current state while skipping empty alternatives.

When verification mode is enabled, range close checks account pages lacking user execute-never protection and pages that are simultaneously writable and executable, emitting a single warning per class and accumulating affected page counts derived from range length.

Range coalescer maintains current depth, protection, start address and region marker, normalizes dynamically folded intermediate depths, opens a new range on first observation, and on change of protection, depth or region boundary summarizes the closed interval with scaled size, level name and decoded protections before advancing markers.

Five depth-specific callbacks forward leaf and table values at fixed translation depths to the common coalescer, and a flush operation terminates iteration by submitting the exclusive end with empty protection while normalizing a maximal address to its wrap value.

Public walk entry builds iteration state from caller-supplied address-space info, constrains low address walks to the user limit, selects the kernel level table, installs depth callbacks and a single address interval, then delegates to the generic page-table walker.

Boot-time verification walks the initial kernel address space with output disabled and checking enabled, then reports aggregate insecure-page counts and succeeds only when both user execute-never violations and writable-executable pages are zero.

Boot initializer derives linear-map and physical-map bases from the actual address width, assembles an ordered region-marker list covering linear, conditional sanitizer, module, dynamic allocation, physical-map, input-output and fixed-map areas, publishes it as init-only read-mostly state, prepares level masks and registers the kernel table view.
Debug interface publishes the kernel page-table view as a read-only file whose show handler retrieves stored walk info and runs the generic walk to render current mappings.

Synchronous exception entry for transitional address spaces that dispatches on the leading argument to either install an exception base and signal success for the suspend path or transfer control to a caller-supplied resume target with reordered arguments for the restart path, returning a stub error for any other request.

Exception vector area provides aligned slots for synchronous, interrupt, fast-interrupt and error classes across four execution states, binding only the 64-bit privileged synchronous slot to the transitional handler while all other slots trap as invalid, terminated by a local end label.
Synchronous dispatch contract defines two recognized operation codes for vector installation and soft restart plus a distinct stub error value returned for unexpected requests.

Translation setup contract references symbolic presets for memory attributes, translation-control composition and enabled system control, with feature-gated adjustments for address width, physical size, access-flag handling, permission formats and extended controls.
